fields.label: Float the Settings window
fields.description: Open Settings as a centred floating window instead of a tile. Turn off to get the stock behaviour without disabling the mod.

fields.label: Width, percent of the screen
fields.description: Never smaller than the window's design size (900 px) and never more than 92% of the screen.

fields.label: Height, percent of the screen
fields.description: Never smaller than the window's design size (650 px) and never more than 92% of the screen.
